comments: This submission is for the standalone PageCrit WCAG Tap Target Checker, a free browser-based accessibility evaluation tool focused on WCAG 2.2 target size and spacing.
features: Free WCAG 2.2 tap target checker that evaluates interactive elements for target size and spacing. It identifies controls that may be too small or too close together for accessible touch use and helps locate issues on a webpage.
title: PageCrit WCAG Tap Target Checker
